capabilities: Turn H1-H6 headings into foldable cards arranged as a tree
Edit card content inline with CodeMirror synced to the source
Search the full document with live highlights and match counters
Navigate between parents, siblings, and children with arrow keys
Export a card or subtree as Markdown, rich text, or PNG
disambiguation: Despite the manifest's mind-mapping and Cornell-notes framing, it is a reading/editing view over existing Markdown headings, not a note-creation or canvas tool.
extras: README includes a Chinese-language summary; installation via BRAT is described for pre-release use, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it because long documents are hard to scan, wanting readers to keep the big picture while diving into details.
problem: Long documents are hard to scan in a normal editor, so readers lose the big picture while diving into details.

relations.evidence: Inline editing — click a card to edit with CodeMirror, always in sync with the source

summary: Renders a Markdown document's headings as foldable tree-arranged cards with inline editing, full-text search, keyboard navigation, and export.
